purpose: Direction gate for deciding which-side TL is eligible to draw on each source timeframe.

terms.HL: A timeframe-local upper/lower pair tied to the structural reversal that established the selected TL direction.
terms.TL: Trendline candidate drawn in the direction allowed by the HL decision gate.
terms.retracement_38: Minimum retracement used to recognize/confirm a reaction Turn/Pivot. It is NOT the HL price.

rule.before_hl_break: Keep the trend-following TL direction that was valid before the HL break.
rule.after_hl_break: When price breaks the timeframe-local HL, switch eligibility to the TL on the breakout side.
rule.scope: Evaluate independently on each source timeframe before Plan-B display copying.
rule.display_copy: After a source timeframe selects its TL, copy the exact selected geometry to its Plan-B display timeframe(s); do not re-decide direction on the destination chart.
rule.hl_display: Always draw both HL lines whether price has broken either line or not.

RISING.lower_hl: confirmed LOW immediately before the breakout HIGH
RISING.upper_hl: previous confirmed HIGH that was first broken to establish the rising structural switch

FALLING.upper_hl: confirmed HIGH immediately before the breakout LOW
FALLING.lower_hl: previous confirmed LOW that was first broken to establish the falling structural switch

rule.continuation: After the switch, later continuation HH/LL breaks do not move the HL pair; change the pair only on the next opposite structural switch.

important: HL color must match the source timeframe TL color.
Both upper and lower HL lines remain visible regardless of break status.
HL anchors must be 38%-confirmed pivots, but 38% itself is not an HL price.
The HL pair is tied to the first structural breakout that established the selected TL direction, not simply the latest two pivots.
RISING: broken previous HIGH + reversal-origin LOW.
FALLING: reversal-origin HIGH + broken previous LOW.
Continuation breaks do not move the pair.
Video comparison is still required before this research rule is promoted.
HL break-to-TL switching remains disabled until video validation.

research_candidate.display_scope: source timeframe chart only during validation
